Do you long to behold, or are you just content patching yourself up in your brokenness?
Do you long to be beautiful with God's holiness right down to your very core?
Or are you content with surface appearances?
Do you long to be home with God?
Or are you busy making this life your home?
We live for the things we long for.
We anticipate what we desire most.
Christ, our God in Jesus Christ is God with us.
Why would you live for anything less?
Let's pray.
Take a moment in the quietness of your heart, consider perhaps some of the lesser anticipations
and longings that have been crowding out this supreme anticipation.
Put those before the Lord in repentance.
Lord God, we confess that we are too easily pleased.
Our longings are too small, our desires too narrow.
Lord, we pray that You would enlarge our hearts, that we would long for You,
that we would long for this new life, that we would long to be living it out
now and increasing holiness and increasing security despite what goes on
around us in this world. Father, we pray that the temptations to this
This tawdry, vanity fair throws at us, we pray that those temptations would be seen
in light of the surpassing glory of you and the new Jerusalem, the promise that you hold
out to us.
We pray that you give us faith to live as citizens of that far country, that holy city.
We pray that you give us grace that many might come with us there.
And we ask this in Christ's name, amen.
